subtasks.title: Add Audio Sync to Export
subtasks.description: Ensure exported video includes original audio track synchronized with overlay.
acceptance_criteria: Captures audio from original video element
Combines audio track with canvas video stream
Audio remains synchronized throughout export
Handles videos without audio track gracefully
subtasks.notes:
Enhanced audio synchronization in useVideoExport.ts:

1. Added MIME types with audio codec specifications (vp9,opus / vp8,opus) for better audio encoding quality
2. Updated getBestMimeType to accept withAudio parameter for audio-aware format selection - now selects appropriate codecs based on audio availability
3. Implemented 4-step audio synchronization strategy:
   - Step 1: Seek video to start time BEFORE capturing audio stream
   - Step 2: Capture audio AFTER seeking to maintain position sync
   - Step 3: Select MIME type AFTER determining audio availability for optimal codec
   - Step 4: Play video with combined streams for natural playback sync
4. Improved captureAudioStream with comprehensive documentation about how synchronization is maintained through cloned tracks from captureStream()
5. Updated combineStreams with synchronization mechanism details
6. Fixed missing hasAudio in error state

Acceptance criteria met:
- ✓ Captures audio from original video element via captureStream()
- ✓ Combines audio track with canvas video stream
- ✓ Audio remains synchronized through documented 4-step strategy
- ✓ Handles videos without audio track gracefully (returns null, hasAudioTrack=false)
